ex-b1.title: Marching in Place
ex-b1.desc: Ghar ke andar aasan aur ghutno ke liye soft cardio warm-up jo body ko jagata hai.
ex-b1.whatYouLearn: Rhythm mein qadam uthana, seedha posture aur relaxed arms.

guidedSteps.start: Paon barabar khol kar seedhe khare hon, kandhe bilkul relax rakhein.
guidedSteps.move: Daayan ghutna kamar tak halka sa uthayein aur baayan haath aage hilayein.
guidedSteps.next: Ab paon narmi se neeche rakhein aur baayan ghutna aur daayan haath badlein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Zameen par zor se paon marne ya kandhe aage jhukane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Ghutno ko halka narm rakhein aur chahein to deewar ya kursi ke paas khare hon.

ex-b1.tip: Apna pasandeeda gaana lagayein—muskurate hue marching bohot aasan lagti hai!

ex-b2.title: Arm Circles
ex-b2.desc: Kandhon aur baazuon ki thakan door karne ke liye halki mobility exercise.
ex-b2.whatYouLearn: Gardan par zor dale bina kandhon ko gol ghumana.

guidedSteps.start: Seedhe khare ho kar dono baazu kandhon ke barabar sides mein phelayein.
guidedSteps.move: Kandhon se aage ki taraf gol aur smooth circles banayein.
guidedSteps.next: 12 circles ke baad thora rukein aur ab peeche ki taraf gol ghumayein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Kandhon ko kaanon tak upar uthane ya bohot tez ghumane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Agar baazu thak jayein to kabhi bhi 5 second neeche rakh kar aaraam karein.

ex-b2.tip: Gardan ko lamba aur sukoon mein rakhein aur aasan saans lein.

ex-b3.title: Wall Push-ups
ex-b3.desc: Kalaiyon par bojh dale bina seene aur baazuon ko mazboot banane ka aasan tariqa.
ex-b3.whatYouLearn: Deewar ke sahare seedhe posture ke sath safe push-up technique.

guidedSteps.start: Mazboot deewar se ek baazu ke faasle par khare hon aur hatheliyan seene ke samne rakhein.
guidedSteps.move: Kohniyan aahista se mod kar seena 2 second mein deewar ke paas layein.
guidedSteps.next: Saans bahar nikalte hue haathon se push karke wapas seedhe hon.
guidedSteps.mistake: Kamar ko beech se andar jhukane ya kohniyan zyada bahar phelane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Tasalli kar lein ke paon phisal nahi rahe aur movement control mein rakhein.

ex-b3.tip: Aasani ke liye deewar ke thora qareeb aayein, ya taqat barhne par thora peeche haten!

ex-b4.title: Bodyweight Squats
ex-b4.desc: Taangon aur thighs ko mazboot banane wali sab se aham rozmarra exercise.
ex-b4.whatYouLearn: Aeri zameen par tika kar kursi par baithne jaisa sahi squat posture.

guidedSteps.start: Paon kandhon se thora zyada khol kar seena seedha rakhein.
guidedSteps.move: Hips ko peeche dhakelen jaise peeche kisi kursi par baith rahe hon.
guidedSteps.next: Aeriyon se zor de kar aaram se wapas seedhe khare ho jayein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Ghutno ko andar ki taraf milne ya aeriyan zameen se uthane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Sirf itna neeche jayein jitna ghutno ko sukoon lage—half squat bhi zabardast hai!

ex-b4.tip: Confidence ke liye peeche ek kursi rakh lein aur halka touch karke wapas uthein.

ex-b5.title: Standing Knee Raises
ex-b5.desc: Zameen par lete baghair core aur balance behtar karne ki aasan exercise.
ex-b5.whatYouLearn: Khare reh kar balance rakhna aur pet ke muscles ka halka istemal.

guidedSteps.start: Seedhe khare hon aur haath kamar par ya samne rakhein.
guidedSteps.move: Pet ko halka tight karke daayan ghutna kamar ki height tak uthayein.
guidedSteps.next: Paon narmi se neeche rakhein aur ab baayan ghutna upar uthayein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Ghutna upar karne ke liye kamar peeche jhukane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Extra balance ke liye kursi ke peeche khare ho sakte hain.

ex-b5.tip: Jab ghutna upar aaye to halka sa saans bahar chhoren!

ex-b6.title: Gentle Stretching
ex-b6.desc: Thakan utarne aur jism mein taazgi lane ke liye poori body ka narm khichao.
ex-b6.whatYouLearn: Gehri saanson ke sath kandhon aur kamar ko aaram se kholna.

guidedSteps.start: Paon barabar khol kar khare hon aur kandhe dheele chhor dein.
guidedSteps.move: Gehri saans lete hue dono baazu sar ke upar le ja kar haath milayein.
guidedSteps.next: Daayein taraf halka sa jhukein, 2 saans rukein, phir baayein taraf jhukein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Saans rokne ya jhatke se khinchne se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Sirf itna stretch karein jahan maza aaye—dard tak kabhi na jayein.

ex-b6.tip: Aahista saans lena body ko relax aur flexible hone ka ishara deta hai.

ex-b7.title: Easy Walking
ex-b7.desc: Rozana ki movement, hazme aur fresh mood ke liye aasan indoor walking.
ex-b7.whatYouLearn: Natural chalne ki raftaar, seedhi nazar aur relaxed arms.

guidedSteps.start: Nazar samne rakh kar seedhe khare hon aur baazu dheele chhor dein.
guidedSteps.move: Aeri se panje tak aaramdayak speed mein chalna shuru karein.
guidedSteps.next: Har qadam ke sath baazuon ko aasan andaaz mein hilne dein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Neeche paon ki taraf dekh kar gardan jhukane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Rasta saaf rakhein aur baad mein peene ke liye paani paas rakhein.

ex-b7.tip: Agar aap chalte hue aaram se baat kar sakte hain to aap bilkul sahi speed par hain!

ex-m1.title: Posture Superman & Cobra Flow
ex-m1.desc: Seene ko kholta hai aur chair par baithne ki thakan aur kamar dard door karta hai.
ex-m1.whatYouLearn: Gardan par zor dale baghair kamar aur kandhe mazboot karna.

guidedSteps.start: Mat par pet ke bal letein aur baazu aage phelayein.
guidedSteps.move: Seena aur haath halke se upar uthayein aur kandhe peeche le jayein.
guidedSteps.next: 2 second ruk kar narmi se wapas neeche aayein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Sar ko jhatke se upar uthane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Nazrein neeche mat par rakhein aur movement control mein rakhein.

ex-m1.tip: Gardan ko aasan rakhein—height se zyada sahi tariqa zaroori hai!

ex-m2.title: Bicep Curl & Overhead Reach
ex-m2.desc: Halke dumbbells ya paani ki bottles ke sath baazuon ko strong banane wali exercise.
ex-m2.whatYouLearn: Kamar hilaye baghair smooth bicep curl aur overhead press.

guidedSteps.start: Paon barabar khol kar halke weights ke sath seedhe khare hon.
guidedSteps.move: Weight ko aaram se kandhon tak layein.
guidedSteps.next: Ab sar ke upar press karein aur wapas aahista neeche layein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Weight uthane ke liye kamar ko jhatka dene se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Upar uthate waqt pet halka sa tight rakhein.

ex-m2.tip: Agar dumbbells na hon to 500ml ki paani ki bottles best kaam karti hain!

ex-m3.title: Khushgawar Step-Back Lunges
ex-m3.desc: Taangon ko mazboot banati hai aur rozana ka balance behtar karti hai.
ex-m3.whatYouLearn: Balance ke sath peeche qadam rakh kar dono ghutne modna.

guidedSteps.start: Kamar par haath rakh kar seedhe khare hon.
guidedSteps.move: Ek paon peeche le ja kar dono ghutno ko halke se moden.
guidedSteps.next: Aage wali aeri se zor de kar khare hon aur side badlein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Aage wale ghutne ko andar jhukne se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Extra balance ke liye kisi mazboot kursi ka sahara le sakte hain.

ex-m3.tip: Seena seedha rakhein aur har qadam aaram se uthayein!

ex-m4.title: Desi Bhangra Cardio Bounce
ex-m4.desc: Dhol ki beat jaisa mazedar cardio jo ghutno ke liye bhi bilkul soft hai.
ex-m4.whatYouLearn: Halke bounce ke sath kandhon aur haathon ka energetic rhythm.

guidedSteps.start: Narm ghutno aur pyaari muskurahat ke sath khare hon.
guidedSteps.move: Panjon par halka sa bounce karte hue kandhe hilayein.
guidedSteps.next: Dono baazu khushi se upar uthayein aur saans barqarar rakhein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Sakht ghutno ke sath bhari qadam rakhne se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Bounce nahi karna to bas step-tap karke bhi maza le sakte hain!

ex-m4.tip: Apna pasandeeda gaana chalayein—muskurate hue cardio bohot jaldi ho jata hai!

ex-a1.title: Sun Flow & Full-Body Stretch
ex-a1.desc: Poore jism mein taazgi lane ke liye plank aur squat ka khoobsurat combo.
ex-a1.whatYouLearn: Saans ke sath plank aur squat ka smooth flow.

guidedSteps.start: Mat ke peeche seedhe khare ho jayein.
guidedSteps.move: Neeche jhuk kar haathon se high plank mein jayein.
guidedSteps.next: 5 second ruk kar wapas aayein aur squat se aahista khare hon.
guidedSteps.mistake: Plank mein saans rokne ya kamar neeche girane se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Aasani ke liye ghutno par plank kar sakte hain.

ex-a1.tip: Apni saans ki raftaar se chalein—koi jaldi nahi.

ex-a2.title: Mat Par Dumbbell Chest Press
ex-a2.desc: Seene aur baazuon ki taqat ke liye sukoon bhari exercise.
ex-a2.whatYouLearn: Mat ke support ke sath safe chest press.

guidedSteps.start: Ghutne mod kar kamar ke bal mat par letein.
guidedSteps.move: Weights ko seene ke upar seedha press karein.
guidedSteps.next: 3 second mein aahista neeche layein jab tak baazu mat ko chhoo lein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Kohniyan zameen par patakhne se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Upar uthate waqt aaram se saans bahar nikalein.

ex-a2.tip: Mat ko gentle guide samjhein—halka touch karke wapas press karein!

ex-a3.title: Squat & Knee Lift Rhythm
ex-a3.desc: Taangon aur core ke liye zabardast stamina combo.
ex-a3.whatYouLearn: Squat ke baad samne wali kohni ki taraf ghutna uthana.

guidedSteps.start: Paon barabar khol kar seena seedha rakhein.
guidedSteps.move: Aeriyon par wazan rakh kar aaramdayak squat mein baithein.
guidedSteps.next: Uthte hue ek ghutna samne wali kohni ki taraf uthayein aur side badlein.
guidedSteps.mistake: Haathon se gardan khinchne se bachein.
guidedSteps.safety: Kamar ko narmi se ghumayein aur comfortable speed rakhein.

ex-a3.tip: Ghutno ko khush rakhne ke liye peeche kursi par baithne jaisa andaaz rakhein!

meal-1.name: Masala Oats & Elaichi Chai
meal-1.serving: 1 garam bowl + 1 cup kam cheeni elaichi chai
meal-1.summary: Haldi, matar aur gajar ke saath bana mazedar namkeen dalia jo subah bhar energy de.
steps: Oats aur zeera 2 minute halka bhoon lein.
Sabziyan, paani aur chutki haldi daal kar pakayein.
Garam elaichi chai ke saath enjoy karein.

meal-2.name: Moong Daal Chilla & Pudina Chutney
meal-2.summary: Protein se bharpoor daal ke crispy chille aur taza pudine dahi ki chutney.
ingredients: Kata pyaaz, dhaniya aur hari mirch
steps: Daal ko adrak ke saath pees kar batter bana lein.
Tawe par sunehra chilla sek lein.
Hari chutney ke saath garam khayein.

meal-3.name: Berry Badam Lassi Smoothie Bowl
meal-3.summary: Taza dahi ki lassi jisme berries, chia seeds aur bhune hue badam shamil hain.
steps: Dahi aur berries ko smooth blend kar lein.
Bowl mein nikal kar upar badam aur seeds sajayein.

meal-4.name: Grilled Paneer Tikka & Daal Thali
meal-4.summary: Masaledar paneer tikka, tadka daal, chakki ki roti, kheere ka raita aur taza aam.
steps: Paneer ko dahi aur halke tikka masale mein marinate karke grill karein.
Garam daal, roti aur thande raite ke saath khayein.

meal-5.name: Chicken Tikka Quinoa & Kachumber Bowl
meal-5.summary: Smoky tandoori chicken aur taza nimbu wale kachumber salad ka mazedar combo.
steps: Chicken ko juicy aur sunehra hone tak grill karein.
Sabziyon par nimbu aur chaat masala chhirkein aur upar rakhein.

meal-6.name: Chana Masala & Brown Rice
meal-6.summary: Tamatar aur adrak mein pake safed chane jo dopahar bhar taqat barqarar rakhein.
steps: Chanon ko tamatar ki gravy mein 10 minute pakayein.
Garam chawalon aur nimbu ke saath khayein.

meal-7.name: Herb Baked Salmon & Sabziyan
meal-7.summary: Raat ke liye halka aur omega-rich khana shakarkandi aur hari sabziyon ke saath.
ingredients: Olive oil, lehsan aur kali mirch
steps: Fish aur sabziyon par masala aur olive oil lagayein.
16 minute tak narm aur sunehra hone tak bake karein.

meal-8.name: Palak Tofu & Multigrain Roti
meal-8.summary: Iron se bharpoor palak ki mazedar gravy aur multigrain phulka roti.
steps: Palak ubal kar adrak ke saath pees lein.
Lehsan ke tadke mein pakayein aur tofu shamil karein.

meal-9.name: Bhune Makhane & Badam Crunch
meal-9.summary: Shaam ki chai ke saath halka aur crispy desi snack desi ghee aur kali mirch ke saath.
steps: Halki aanch par makhane aur badam crispy hone tak bhoonein.
Namak aur kali mirch chhirak kar enjoy karein.

meal-10.name: Taza Fruit Chaat & Dahi
meal-10.summary: Saib, anar aur amrood ki chatpati chaat chaat masale aur thande dahi ke saath.
steps: Mausami phal chhote tukron mein kaatein.
Chaat masala mila kar thanda khayein.
